guards.name: the model name (series\0n) counts as a name

anchors.name: aria-six: seven bars take six distinct patterns, the seventh the first's
aria-six: two series of one name share one
label-custom: the description is the label
label-none: no series, a role and no label
merge-enable: aria from a merge is off
scope: the renamed series picks on, the old name keeps its decal
pre-frames: a frame's enabled false outweighs the base's show
pre-frames: a frame's show turns it on
pre-media: a unit's show is read, the default's is not
pre-label: the frame's, the merge's, not the default's, not under label.enabled false
pre-edges: show over enabled, a null show kept out, a null enabled on, the null label filled, the null description not moved
